name: cloud-engineering-connector
description: Cloud-hosted MCP connector for rigorous software engineering, architecture, code review, and evidence-aware workflows.

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const name=fs.readFileSync('wrangler.toml','utf8').split(/\r?\n/).find(line=>line.trim().startsWith('name ='));if(name?.trim()!=='name = \"chat-gpt111\"')throw new Error('wrangler.toml must target chat-gpt111');" && node --check worker.js && node --check test/worker.test.js && npx --yes wrangler@4.155.0 deploy --dry-run
